name: en passant inside a two-move turn
description: Not a game -- the smallest spec that reached rust/src/game.rs:1210 before the validator refused it (Q341). rules.turn gives a player two moves, and the en-passant window a double step opened was still open on that same player's second move, so the pawn on a2 could take its own pawn on b4 in passing; the strike rule turned the self-capture into a panic, because strike_writes reads the schema-11 own-contact tables, which are empty when no contact link declares own: true. Q531 refused the self-capture in the core, and SR7a (L1, generation 97) lifted the refusal: the window is the opponent's, opened by the mover's last double step of the turn and open for the opponent's first move only. Used by tests/test_spec.py, tests/test_engine.py and tests/test_en_passant_long_turn.py.
